scope: 2023 English Uprising v23-10-12, standard 2–4-player multiplayer including required two-player Rival, optional standard CHOAM; no solo, Rival variants, six-player teams or cross-game expansions. Relevant official FAQ January 13 2025 clarifications included.
grading: All requested material parts required; abstention partial, contradiction incorrect. Grade semantics independent of support label. Unsupported guesses separately flagged. No cross-answer borrowing.

answers.expected_answer: Shuffle all four III cards at the bottom, five randomly dealt of nine II cards above, one randomly dealt of three I cards on top: ten total. Return unused cards to the box without looking.
answers.novelty: Conflict deck construction

answers.expected_answer: Four players start at 1 VP; three at 0. Each has two Agents on Leader and third beside board, three troops in garrison with remaining nine in supply, and one water.
answers.novelty: Player setup

answers.expected_answer: May Reveal early; no more turns this phase after Reveal. Only cards remaining in hand and just revealed supply Reveal effects, not Agent-turn cards. Clean Up puts all Agent and Reveal cards in discard pile.
answers.novelty: Reveal commitment and destinations

answers.expected_answer: Entry costs paid immediately before any card or space effects; cannot use later gains to pay entry. One card sends one Agent using one matching icon. No-icon card cannot be played on an Agent turn.
answers.novelty: Entry legality and costs

answers.expected_answer: May deploy all three newly recruited plus at most two older garrison troops, five total. Normal deployment unavailable at noncombat space. Recruit from own supply into garrison; empty supply prevents recruiting.
answers.novelty: Recruit and deployment limits

answers.expected_answer: Spy Agent icon permits a connected space without recalling Spy. Infiltrate recalls own connected Spy to bypass another player Agent. Gather Intelligence recalls own connected Spy to draw, chosen immediately after placement before card/space effects. Same Spy cannot do both; separate Spies can.
answers.novelty: Distinct spy functions and timing

answers.expected_answer: Strength 11 (2+2+3+4). No units means zero strength regardless swords. Without a unit cannot participate in Combat Intrigue.
answers.novelty: Strength and eligibility

answers.expected_answer: May act again after earlier pass; closes only when all involved players pass consecutively. Adjust strength for effects. After all rewards troops return to supply not garrison, sandworms to bank, Combat markers reset zero.
answers.novelty: Combat priority and cleanup

answers.expected_answer: Each tied first gets second reward and nobody wins or takes card. In four-player game remaining players compete for third; in three-player game no further rewards. Zero strength never rewarded.
answers.novelty: Tie for first outcome branches

answers.expected_answer: One or more sandworms doubles, never quadruples. Control and battle icons do not double. Optional reward cost may be paid second time: 3 spice for 1 VP or 6 for 2, not free second VP.
answers.novelty: Doubling scope and cost exception

answers.expected_answer: After winning and taking Conflict card face up in supply check another face-up Conflict or Objective with same icon; must flip pair face down for 1 VP. At Endgame wild can match any of three icons in supply, pair flipped for 1 VP.
answers.novelty: Battle icon match

answers.expected_answer: Reach 2 gets 1 VP lost below 2. Reach 4 gets track bonus retained if falling below, can earn again on re-reaching. First to 4 gets Alliance and its VP; tie does not steal, opponent must rise higher. Transfer loses old holder VP and gives new holder VP.
answers.novelty: Influence thresholds and Alliance

answers.expected_answer: Before between or after Reveal effects; can pool and split. Refill Row to five immediately; may buy replacement with remaining Persuasion. Acquired card face-up discard, cannot use immediately; unspent Persuasion lost.
answers.novelty: Acquisition timing and destination

answers.expected_answer: Makers phase adds one bonus spice on each unoccupied Maker space, accumulating; visiting collects all bonus spice. Shield Wall blocks worms at Arrakeen, Spice Refinery, Imperial Basin until removed to box. Maker Hooks prerequisite when specified; summoning directly bank to Conflict, never garrison.
answers.novelty: Maker and worm restrictions

answers.expected_answer: Check in Recall at end of round, not immediately at 10 VP. Resolve Endgame Intrigue first then highest VP wins. Ties spice then Solari then water then garrisoned troops.
answers.novelty: End trigger and scoring

answers.expected_answer: 20 standard contracts: two face up, eighteen in bank. Add four Intrigue and four Imperium; Shaddam optional. Ten contrasting-back contracts are only Rise of Ix compatibility, excluded from standard setup.
answers.novelty: CHOAM setup and compatibility boundary

answers.expected_answer: Take one of two face-up into supply then refill face up from bank; if all taken gain 2 Solari (also without module). Harvest: visit Maker and gain specified total spice that turn including other sources. Immediate upon taking. Acquire The Spice Must Flow on next acquiring that card.
answers.novelty: CHOAM taking and types

answers.expected_answer: Cannot complete now; must have held contract when Agent sent, wait future turn. Announce completion, gain printed rewards, flip face down and leave in supply.
answers.novelty: CHOAM ownership timing and destination

answers.expected_answer: One shared Rival. Rival gets Ornithopter Objective, other two randomly humans; Rival never First Player. Marker alternates humans, Rival considered clockwise from First Player and acts between humans each round. Takes Agent turns while it has Agent in supply, never Reveals.
answers.novelty: Required two-player setup and turn order

answers.expected_answer: Occupied: ignore and reveal again. Place Spy tries empty designated post, ignore placement if none, then reveal another card regardless because no Agent sent. Ignore normal space costs/effects; use Hagal effects only. Empty deck or Reshuffle: immediately reshuffle Hagal and continue.
answers.novelty: Rival card resolution

answers.expected_answer: Omit Objectives whose 1–3P or 4/6P mark mismatches count; shuffle, each takes one random face up in supply. First Player is holder of marked Objective. Shaddam cannot be chosen without CHOAM.
answers.novelty: Objective eligibility and Leader restriction

answers.expected_answer: Bank resources and sandworms not limited; substitute conveniently. Cannot recruit troops from empty personal supply until returned. Resource gains come from bank and payments return to bank.
answers.novelty: Component exhaustion and bank destinations

answers.expected_answer: Round Start, Player Turns, Combat, Makers, Recall. Start reveals top Conflict face up atop previous remaining cards then each draws five. If no Endgame, recall Agents to Leaders, pass First Player clockwise and begin next round (two-player Rival exception).
answers.novelty: Round order and restart

answers.expected_answer: Resolve effects in any order after placement, but entry requirements and costs must be met before any effects. Cannot rely on Influence gained by the visit for its entry requirement.
answers.novelty: Effect-order versus entry requirement priority

answers.expected_answer: Only once per turn, except sandworm-doubled Conflict rewards. Most effects mandatory except may, optional arrow payment and black-X trash. Direct self-trash mandatory. All Intrigue conditions/costs required to play it.
answers.source_references: Main pp9,20; FAQ p3 optional effects/paying a cost
answers.novelty: Optional effect boundary and Intrigue exception

answers.expected_answer: Unoccupied observation post, from supply. If none in supply may first recall one of own Spies for no effect. Specified icon must connect to post or cannot place there.
answers.novelty: Spy placement and exhaustion

answers.expected_answer: No to all. Infiltrate bypasses another player Agent; still play a card and meet entry costs/requirements. Two Spies can pay different effects (Infiltrate and Gather Intelligence), not duplicate Gather Intelligence.
answers.novelty: Spy ownership and per-effect recall limits

answers.expected_answer: Winning respective Conflict puts control marker on flag replacing opponent. Controller receives 1 Solari at Arrakeen/Refinery or 1 spice at Basin whenever anyone including self visits. Reveal of controlled location Conflict permits one troop from supply directly to Conflict.
answers.novelty: Control transfer, repeated benefit and defense

answers.expected_answer: Tied second each get third reward; winner keeps first and card, no other rewards. Tied third receive nothing. Three tied first each get second, no winner/card and no further rewards.
answers.novelty: Remaining combat tie outcome branches

answers.expected_answer: Only first and second rewarded, third only used for a tie for second. Two humans plus standard Rival use the same two-/three-player reward rules; Rival competes normally.
answers.source_references: Main p14; Supplements p5 Combat; FAQ p1 Conflict
answers.novelty: Untied low-player-count rewards

answers.expected_answer: Plot during own Agent/Reveal turns, Combat during Combat with a unit, Endgame at game end. Unplayed face down separate from deck, owner may inspect; played resolved cards face up Intrigue discard. Exhaustion reshuffles Intrigue discard into new deck.
answers.source_references: Main p7 / extraction 345–354; FAQ p2 Intrigue cards
answers.novelty: Intrigue storage, timing and exhaustion

answers.expected_answer: Ordinary discard from hand and cannot be Intrigue unless specified. Secrets steals one random Intrigue from each opponent with four or more, in addition to drawing one from deck and gaining Bene Gesserit Influence.
answers.source_references: Main p20 / extraction 1104–1106,1179–1181; Supplements p2; FAQ p2 discard
answers.novelty: Discard type and theft threshold

answers.expected_answer: May trash own hand, discard or in-play card. Ordinary to box; Reserve back to its Reserve stack. Optional unless cost or direct self-trash. The Spice Must Flow acquire VP retained after trashing.
answers.source_references: Main p20 / extraction 1185–1190; FAQ p4 The Spice Must Flow
answers.novelty: Trash locations and persistent acquire VP

answers.expected_answer: Acquire effect once at acquisition not when later played. Reshuffle discard only when unable to draw due to empty deck then continue. Unspent Reveal Persuasion lost, never saved.
answers.novelty: Acquire triggers, reshuffle trigger and resource expiration

answers.expected_answer: Agent-turn and Reveal cards remain in play face up until Reveal Clean Up unless trashed earlier. Bond requires at least one other Fremen in play; two Bond cards can activate each other regardless of order.
answers.novelty: In-play lifetime and Fremen Bond interaction

answers.expected_answer: Recall another Agent from board to Leader, not current-turn Agent; can use on later Agent turn same round. Retreat Conflict to garrison; any number permits zero.
answers.source_references: Main p20 / extraction 1147–1157; FAQ p3 Retreat
answers.novelty: Recall and retreat destinations and reuse

answers.expected_answer: Choose one Faction, both Influence there (not split). Alliance effect requires holding shown Faction Alliance token; minimum-Influence effect requires at least shown value with shown Faction.
answers.novelty: Effect eligibility and indivisible Influence

answers.expected_answer: Former holder chooses one of previously tied opponents to receive token; holder loses Alliance VP and receiver gains it. Below 4 loses token; if no eligible 4+ player return token to board, losing its VP.
answers.novelty: Alliance loss from retreating holder

answers.expected_answer: During Reveal immediately reveal and use this turn; after Reveal keep until next round, then draw five extra. Plot effect for later Reveal stays face up until that Reveal, use then discard.
answers.novelty: Draw timing branches and delayed Plot duration

answers.expected_answer: Tie for first is not a win, cannot play. An appropriate Intrigue received as winning reward can be played immediately.
answers.source_references: FAQ p4 When you win a Conflict
answers.novelty: Win-trigger exception and newly gained card timing

answers.expected_answer: Final tiebreaker is player who most recently took Reveal turn. Scores may exceed printed track maximum 12.
answers.source_references: FAQ p2 Endgame; p4 Victory Points
answers.novelty: Final tiebreaker and score boundary

answers.expected_answer: Completion mandatory; all same-space contracts completed with one Agent placement. Their effects may resolve in any order with space and Agent-box effects; still must hold them at placement.
answers.novelty: Mandatory simultaneous contracts and effect ordering

answers.expected_answer: No, not in possession at start. Sardaukar Commander allows acquiring set-aside Sardaukar contract instead of generally available one when taking a contract. Emperor of Known Universe restriction starts immediately with Signet Ring Agent placement and lasts that turn only.
answers.source_references: Main p17; FAQ p3 Shaddam Corrino IV
answers.novelty: Shaddam contract choice and restriction duration

answers.expected_answer: Feyd starts leftmost Training space, stays forever on rightmost once reached. Lady Jessica side starts up, not Reverend Mother. Reverend Mother ability usable on flip turn.
answers.source_references: Main p17 / extraction 957–964; FAQ p3 Reverend Mother Jessica
answers.novelty: Leader setup and transition timing

answers.expected_answer: Passing 2 upward counts, can repeat by losing then regaining Influence; descending does not count. Spacing Guild Favor triggers discard from hand, not in-play-to-discard Clean Up.
answers.novelty: Threshold crossing and discard-source exception

answers.expected_answer: Accept Contract: Spice Trade, draw card plus contract or 2 Solari, no automatic Faction Influence. Dutiful Service: Emperor, one Emperor Influence plus contract or 2 Solari. Contract fallback if module off or all contracts taken.
answers.novelty: Nonfaction versus Faction contract spaces

answers.expected_answer: Arrakeen City free, troop and card, controller 1 Solari. Fremkit Fremen free, 1 Fremen Influence and card. Research Station City 2 water, two troops and two cards. All Combat.
answers.novelty: Free versus paid card/recruit Combat spaces

answers.expected_answer: Deep Desert 3 water, 4 spice OR two worms; Hagga 1 water, 2 spice OR one worm. Both collect all bonus spice even with worms. Worm choice requires Maker Hooks, not spent; cannot summon into Shield-Wall-protected Conflict.
answers.source_references: Supplements pp1–2; Main p10; FAQ p2 Maker hooks
answers.novelty: Maker choice excludes base spice but retains bonus

answers.expected_answer: City access, 2+ Fremen Influence, no resource cost. Option one Hooks if needed, one troop, one water; option two one water and may remove wall. Option two gives no troop or Hooks. Combat space.
answers.novelty: Sietch mutually exclusive option branches

answers.expected_answer: Landsraad 5 Solari each visit. First Councilor to empty seat, +2 Persuasion each Reveal rest of game; later 2 spice, Intrigue, three troops. Not Combat, cannot normally deploy recruited troops.
answers.novelty: High Council persistent upgrade versus revisit rewards

answers.expected_answer: Landsraad 8 Solari before any Swordmaster, then 6; once per player per game. Third Agent from beside board onto Leader immediately usable same round and rest of game. Rival also lowers cost.
answers.novelty: Swordmaster dynamic cost and immediate action capacity

answers.expected_answer: Landsraad, 2+ Emperor Influence, 3 Solari. May discard Intrigue to draw Intrigue; recall another Agent and draw card. Not the current Agent. No automatic Emperor Influence.
answers.novelty: Recall-space requirement versus Faction gain

answers.expected_answer: Spice Trade, 2+ Guild Influence, 3 spice. Gain 5 Solari and one Influence any one Faction, not necessarily Guild.
answers.novelty: Shipping qualifying Faction versus chosen gain

answers.expected_answer: Gather Support Landsraad choose 0/2 Solari, two troops either way, plus one water if paid, not Combat. Refinery City choose 0/1 spice, gain 2/4 Solari respectively, controller 1 Solari either way, Combat.
answers.novelty: Optional entry costs and different deployment access

answers.expected_answer: Heighliner 5 spice, Guild Influence +1 and five troops, Combat. Desert Tactics 1 water, Fremen Influence +1 and one troop, optional trash, Combat. Sardaukar 4 spice, Emperor Influence +1 and four troops plus Intrigue, not Combat.
answers.novelty: Faction recruit spaces with different Combat flags

answers.expected_answer: Assembly Hall Landsraad free, Intrigue now, 1 Persuasion at Reveal if own Agent there. Espionage BG 1 spice, 1 BG Influence, card and Spy. Deliver Supplies Guild free, 1 Guild Influence and 1 water. None Combat.
answers.novelty: Persistent location conditional and resource/spy spaces

answers.expected_answer: Each affected opponent moves Spy to empty observation post not connected to this turn Agent destination. Can play without enemy Spy there. Litany red box ignored during Reveal or with gained Agent icon when played normally as Agent card.
answers.source_references: FAQ pp2–3 False Orders/Litany Against Fear
answers.novelty: Specific movement and card-box exceptions

answers.expected_answer: Opponents cannot acquire. You may use other means but 1-Persuasion discount does not apply. If not acquired by end of next Reveal turn, remove from game.
answers.novelty: Removed-row card access and expiry

answers.expected_answer: Four cubes at Influence bottoms, three garrison troops rest supply, two Agents supply and third beside board, three Spies and one water supply, score/Combat zero. Retain Reshuffle in Hagal. Scoring Rival can trigger end at 10+ and win.
answers.novelty: Rival full setup and scoring threat

answers.expected_answer: As soon as total resources reaches printed value; Solari spice Intrigues water each unit one. Spend only threshold, prioritizing Solari then spice then Intrigue then water; keep leftovers. Third Agent immediately available including current round.
answers.source_references: Supplements p5; p2 Swordmaster; FAQ p3 Rivals
answers.novelty: Automated mixed-resource upgrade timing

answers.expected_answer: Each set 7 Solari, 7 spice, 3 Intrigues or 3 water gives 1 VP whenever available. No mixed seven-resource VP purchase; mixed total only used for Swordmaster.
answers.source_references: Supplements p5 Buying Victory Points diagram
answers.novelty: Rival homogeneous conversion thresholds

answers.expected_answer: Choose least Influence, ties leftmost priority. Gains/losses of Influence VP and Alliance VP as humans, no 4-track bonus. Number means Faction at that position in printed priority list.
answers.novelty: Rival priority and track-bonus exception

answers.expected_answer: Cannot switch to other; reveal again. Accept Contract/Shipping based on Guild Influence; Deliver Supplies/Heighliner based on Conflict tier I/II/III. Use card printed condition.
answers.source_references: Supplements p4 Special Instructions; FAQ p3 Rivals
answers.novelty: Rival conditional destination cannot fallback

answers.expected_answer: Still deploy up to two available garrison troops at Combat. New troops at noncombat go garrison. Missing 2-Influence bonus does not block placement, just no bonus. Use only Hagal effects, not ordinary board effects.
answers.novelty: Rival deployment and conditional bonus failure

answers.expected_answer: First available Faction post by priority; if all full ignore placement. Third/final supply Spy placed triggers immediately recalling other two and printed Scheme. Never Infiltrate/Gather Intelligence.
answers.novelty: Rival automated spy placement and Scheme trigger

answers.expected_answer: Deploy Scheme recruits on same-turn Combat placement. Place Spy card still followed by another Hagal reveal whether placement succeeds or not, because no Agent has been sent.
answers.novelty: Scheme recruitment timing before placement

answers.expected_answer: Always take bonus spice. With Hooks and summonable Conflict summons one at Hagga/two Deep instead of base. Without Hooks or if protected, summons none and gains base spice (2/4). At Imperial Basin gains base1. Hagal wall removal requires Hooks.
answers.novelty: Rival mandatory worm choice and fallback

answers.expected_answer: Start Combat in turn order, only with deployed unit: one Hagal card, bottom swords only added. Reshuffle and draw again on Reshuffle. Humans then Combat Intrigue before resolution. No unit no bonus.
answers.novelty: Automated bonus precedes human response

answers.expected_answer: Normal control visit bonus and defensive supply troop; win card/match icons; sandworms double. Always buy optional Conflict VP if can pay resources or required Spy recall. Never contracts; each contract reward becomes 2 Solari even with CHOAM.
answers.novelty: Rival reward choices and module exception

answers.expected_answer: After Reveal Cards and before Clean Up, at any point while resolving effects; announce total, set marker and update as needed. Above20 flip +20 side and count again from beginning of track.
answers.novelty: Flexible strength-setting timing and marker overflow

answers.expected_answer: Activated when playing Signet Ring on an Agent turn, not when merely revealing. Left Leader ability used as described. Cards of any type can override normal rules.
answers.novelty: Generic Signet trigger and rules precedence

answers.expected_answer: Return one of own Spies from observation post to supply, usually a cost for card effect. Card recall distinct from the two voluntary recalls for Infiltrate or Gather Intelligence; it does not automatically give either benefit.
answers.novelty: Card recall destination versus voluntary recall purpose

answers.expected_answer: Trash an Intrigue of choice from own hand. Ordinary discard chooses a non-Intrigue from hand unless explicitly specified.
answers.novelty: Dedicated Intrigue trash versus ordinary deck discard

answers.expected_answer: Yes. Sandworm doubling of a one-Influence reward gives two separate gains, which may use the same Faction or two different Factions. A single two-Influence effect instead chooses just one Faction and cannot be split.
answers.source_references: Main PDF p14 Sandworm Reward Doubling example and p20 Influence icons / extraction 778–791,1123–1126
answers.novelty: Explicit doubled-reward Influence split exception versus indivisible two-Influence effect

answers.expected_answer: Resolve the Signet Ring ability printed on the selected Rival card as the Hagal effect. No human deck Signet Ring card or Reveal turn is involved; Rival never Reveals.
answers.source_references: Supplements PDF pp3–4 Rival card anatomy and House Hagal Signet Ring icon
answers.novelty: Rival Hagal Signet trigger distinct from human Signet Ring Agent-card trigger

answers.expected_answer: Maker Hooks icon takes a token onto garrison only if Rival lacks one. Shield Wall removal effect removes the wall if Rival has Hooks and wall remains; without Hooks ignore the removal effect, and if wall already gone no wall remains to remove.
answers.source_references: Supplements PDF p4 Hagal icon explanations
answers.novelty: Rival-only prerequisite on wall removal, and idempotent Hooks acquisition

answers.expected_answer: Bene Gesserit, no cost, not Combat. Gain one BG Influence and draw one Intrigue from deck. Each opponent with four or more Intrigues gives one randomly selected Intrigue; below four gives none.
answers.source_references: Supplements PDF p2 Secrets; Main p7 Intrigue and p20 Steal Intrigue
answers.novelty: Complete Secrets space procedure; prior Q32 asks only theft selection, not separate deck draw/Influence/access/Combat status

answers.expected_answer: Spice Trade, no entry cost, Combat. Visitor gains one base spice plus all accumulated bonus spice. Controller gains one additional spice whenever anyone visits, including self; a controlling visitor receives both gains.
answers.source_references: Supplements PDF p2 Imperial Basin; Main p10 control
answers.novelty: Imperial Basin base-spice procedure, plus self-controller benefit; prior Maker and control questions never request this complete visit outcome

answers.expected_answer: Reveal top Conflict face up in space next to deck, on top of any Conflict cards still there from earlier rounds. Then each player draws five; card not won in previous round is not taken into a player supply by this placement.
answers.novelty: Current/unclaimed Conflict card destination and replacement order, previously only key background in Q23

answers.expected_answer: Each human puts one cube at bottom of each of four Influence tracks, starting at zero Influence. Alliance tokens are on their marked track spaces, not held by players; nobody starts allied. Shield Wall starts present in marked area below Spice Refinery, protecting its three locations until removed.
answers.source_references: Main PDF pp4–5 and p10 / extraction 239–246,274–278,506–522
answers.novelty: Initial unclaimed Alliances/zero human Influence and initially active protection, distinct from later threshold/transfer questions

answers.expected_answer: Player Turns starts with the First Player marker and proceeds clockwise one turn at a time. Skip anyone who has already Revealed; the phase ends when all players have Revealed. Combat Intrigue likewise begins with First Player and proceeds clockwise among players with at least one unit in the Conflict; each may play any number or pass.
answers.source_references: Main PDF pp8,14; run extraction lines397–459,813–826
answers.novelty: Turn priority, skipped players and phase termination are not requested by Q03/Q08/Q23; Q19 only asks the two-player Rival order. Any-number Combat permission is also unasked.

answers.expected_answer: Reveal Cards, Resolve Reveal Effects, Clean Up, in that order. Reveal all remaining hand cards first; resolve their Reveal effects in any chosen order; then clean up all played cards.
answers.source_references: Main PDF p12; run extraction lines714–748
answers.novelty: Q03 asks card eligibility/destination, Q13 purchase interleaving and Q71 strength timing; none requests the Reveal step sequence or effect-order freedom.

answers.expected_answer: Each human shuffles their identical ten-card starting deck and puts it face down in their supply left of their Leader. Omit CHOAM-marked Imperium/Intrigue cards, shuffle the Intrigue and Imperium decks face down, deal five Imperium cards face up, and place Prepare the Way and The Spice Must Flow in separate Reserve stacks next to the Row. Human Combat marker starts at zero on the indicated initial side; three Spies, Councilor and Control markers start in their supply in clear view.
answers.source_references: Main PDF pp3–5; run extraction lines102–319, especially C1–C3/E/G3/G6
answers.novelty: Initial deck/market preparation and the remaining human component destinations are not requested by Q01/Q02/Q16/Q21/Q60/Q81. These establish playable initial state; not a numerical variant of an existing setup question.

answers.expected_answer: During the player’s Reveal turn, acquire any available card from the five-card Imperium Row or Prepare the Way/The Spice Must Flow from the Reserve, paying the Persuasion cost printed at the top right. Ordinary Persuasion purchasing is a Reveal-turn procedure.
answers.source_references: Main PDF p13 Acquiring Cards and p20 Persuasion; run extraction lines775–806,1256–1259
answers.novelty: Q13 asks spending within Reveal, pooling, replacement and destination; it does not ask the legal purchase sources, printed price or whether an Agent turn permits ordinary purchases. Q34 only asks acquire-box/reshuffle rules.

answers.expected_answer: Ordinary Spy placement and ordinary Recall Spy are permissive: may place/recall. An unpaid optional recall cost gives no associated benefit; Intrigue costs/conditions still must be met to play that Intrigue. Shield Wall destruction is optional. Once removed, return it to the box; it is gone for the rest of the game.
answers.source_references: Main PDF pp10–11; FAQ pp3–4 optional effects/Shield Wall; run main lines577–585,646–665; FAQ lines217–228,304–306
answers.novelty: Q26 asks placement legality, Q73 asks recall resolution/destination and Q49 asks Sietch option outcomes, but none expressly requests these human icon optionality branches or Wall permanence. Q77 is Rival-specific and uses different mandatory automation.

answers.expected_answer: Ordinary access requires an Agent icon actually on the played card matching the destination’s access icon. A connected Spy alone does not give a City-only card access to Shipping. With an actual Spy Agent icon, the card may access a space connected to the player’s deployed Spy, without recalling that Spy for access; normal requirements and costs still apply.
answers.source_references: Main PDF pp9,11; run extraction lines487–500,675–677
answers.novelty: Matching access in Q04’s key is unasked background; Q06 explains a Spy Agent icon without requesting whether a deployed Spy creates one. This is a card-access permission distinction, not a changed destination-name example.

answers.expected_answer: Yes, if the Plot Intrigue is legally playable and provides the needed resource before placement/payment: Plot Intrigues may be played at any point during one of the player’s Agent turns. Pay the destination cost before resolving the destination or played Agent-card effects, so those later gains cannot fund their own entry.
answers.source_references: Main PDF pp7–9; run extraction lines390–394,418–430,504–519
answers.novelty: Consequential pre-entry Plot timing is not tested by Q04’s Agent-card/space prohibition or Q31’s broad card-type windows. It is not permission to pay a cost retroactively; the Plot actually resolves before entry.

answers.expected_answer: Do not cancel the Rival’s remaining Agent turns. Skip the humans who Revealed and continue giving the Rival Agent turns while it has an Agent in its supply. Once both humans have Revealed and the Rival has no Agent remaining in supply, proceed to Combat. The Rival never takes a Reveal turn.
answers.source_references: Main PDF p8 Player Turns; Supplements PDF p4 Rival Agent Turns; run main lines409–429 and supplement lines226–235
answers.novelty: A required standard-Rival phase-termination exception: Main requires revealed humans to be skipped, while the supplement requires a Rival turn as long as an Agent remains and expressly prohibits Rival Reveal. Q19 requests Rival turn order/Reveal status, not termination after both humans Reveal early; Q82 is normal 3–4P. The result is a direct operational reconciliation of these source instructions.

answers.expected_answer: Accept Contract: Spice Trade, Combat no; Arrakeen: City, Combat yes; Assembly Hall: Landsraad, Combat no; Deep Desert: Spice Trade, Combat yes; Deliver Supplies: Spacing Guild, Combat no; Desert Tactics: Fremen, Combat yes; Dutiful Service: Emperor, Combat no; Espionage: Bene Gesserit, Combat no; Fremkit: Fremen, Combat yes; Gather Support: Landsraad, Combat no; Hagga Basin: Spice Trade, Combat yes; Heighliner: Spacing Guild, Combat yes; High Council: Landsraad, Combat no; Imperial Basin: Spice Trade, Combat yes; Imperial Privilege: Landsraad, Combat no; Research Station: City, Combat yes; Sardaukar: Emperor, Combat no; Secrets: Bene Gesserit, Combat no; Shipping: Spice Trade, Combat no; Sietch Tabr: City, Combat yes; Spice Refinery: City, Combat yes; Swordmaster: Landsraad, Combat no. These are the normal access icons; Spy-Agent access is a separate exception.
answers.source_references: Supplements PDF pp1–2 complete standard Board Space Guide
answers.novelty: Consolidated coverage of previously unasked actual board-space access/Combat permissions. Earlier grouped effects/cost questions remain unchanged; this directly requests all reference fields without cosmetic per-space question variants.

answers.expected_answer: When a Conflict card is revealed for a location the human already controls, the controller may immediately deploy one troop from their supply directly to the Conflict.
